Command.description:
The startup commands for the container. You can specify up to 20 commands. Each command can be up to 256 characters long.

> 1. If a startup command contains spaces, such as `sleep 60s`, pass the JSON parameter as `["sleep", "60s"]`.
>
> 2. For complex startup commands, use a combination of `Command: ["/bin/bash"]` and `Arg:["-c", "<your_command>"]`. The `<your_command>` is a user-defined command string that can contain spaces and other characters.

items.description: The content of the container startup command. Each command can be up to 256 characters long.

EnvironmentVars.description: The environment variables for the container. You can specify up to 20 variables.

items.description: The environment variables for the container.

Name.description: The name of the environment variable. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It cannot start with a digit.

Value.description: The value of the environment variable. The value can be up to 256 characters in length.

AppId.description: The ID of the containerized application.

ImageRegistryOptions.description:
The custom options for the image registry. This parameter is a JSON string of key-value pairs.

- Example: {"ImageRegistryType":"https","ImageRegistryServer":"xxx","ImageRegistryUserName":"xxx","ImageRegistryPassword":"xxx"}

Arg.description: The arguments for the container startup command. You can specify up to 10 arguments.

items.description: An argument for the container startup command.

PrologScript.description: The pre-execution script. The script must be Base64-encoded.

Script.description: The job execution script. The script must be Base64-encoded.

AppId.description: The ID of the VM application.

Password.description:
The logon password for the VM. The password must be 8 to 30 characters long. It must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The supported special characters are:

()\`\~!@#$%^&\*-\_+=|{}\[]:;'<>,.?/
For Windows, the password cannot start with a forward slash (/).

> If you specify the \`Password\` parameter, send the request over HTTPS to prevent password leaks.

VolumeMount.description: The volumes to mount to the task. You can specify up to 10 volumes.

items.description: The volumes to mount to the task.

MountPath.description:
The directory in the task where the volume is mounted.

> The content in the mount directory is overwritten by the volume content. Use this parameter with caution.

VolumeDriver.description:
The type of the volume. Valid values:

- alicloud/nas: Mounts a Network Attached Storage (NAS) file system.

- alicloud/oss: Mounts an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

ReadOnly.description: Specifies whether the volume is read-only. The default value is false.

Resource.description: The resource information for the runtime environment.

Cores.description: The number of vCPUs for the runtime environment.

EnableHT.description: Specifies whether to enable hyper-threading for the runtime environment. The default value is true.

Memory.description: The memory size of the runtime environment, in GiB.

items.description: An array of cloud disks.

Type.description: The type of the cloud disk. Currently, only \`System\` is supported, which indicates the system disk.

Size.description: The size of the cloud disk, in GiB.

HostNamePrefix.description:
The hostname prefix for the runtime environment. The prefix has the following limits:

- It cannot start or end with a period (.) or a hyphen (-). It cannot contain consecutive periods or hyphens.

- For Windows: The prefix can be up to 10 characters long. It cannot contain periods or consist of only digits. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

- For Linux: The prefix can be up to 32 characters long. It can contain multiple periods (.). Each segment separated by a period can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

InstanceTypes.description: The instance types for the runtime environment. You can specify up to five instance types.

items.description:
The instance type for the runtime environment.

> This parameter is valid only when \`DeploymentPolicy.AllocationSpec\` is set to \`Standard\`.

RetryPolicy.description: The retry policy for the task.

RetryCount.description: The number of retries. Valid values: 1 to 10. The default value is 3.

ExitCodeActions.description: The retry rules. You can specify up to 10 rules.

items.description: A retry rule.

ExitCode.description: The exit code of the task. This parameter works with \`Action\` to define a job retry rule. Valid values: 0 to 255.

Action.description:
The action to take when the task exits with the specified \`ExitCode\`.

- Retry: The job starts a new retry.

- Exit: The job exits.

ExecutorPolicy.description: The execution policy for the task.

MaxCount.description:
The maximum number of nodes for job execution.

> The value must follow this formula: `MaxCount = (IndexEnd - IndexStart) / IndexStep + 1`

ArraySpec.description:
The details for an array job. The subjob index value is passed to the runtime environment as an environment variable that your application can reference.

- EHPC\_JOB\_NAME: The job name. This matches the JobName parameter.

- EHPC\_JOB\_ID: The job ID.

- EHPC\_TASK\_NAME: The task name. This matches the TaskName parameter.

- EHPC\_EXECUTOR\_ID: The executor ID.

- EHPC\_ARRAY\_TASK\_ID: The subjob index value.

- EHPC\_ARRAY\_TASK\_COUNT: The total number of subjobs.

- EHPC\_ARRAY\_TASK\_MAX: The maximum subjob index. This matches the IndexStart parameter.

- EHPC\_ARRAY\_TASK\_MIN: The minimum subjob index. This matches the IndexEnd parameter.

- EHPC\_ARRAY\_TASK\_STEP: The subjob index step size. This matches the IndexStep parameter.

IndexStart.description: The start index for the array job. Valid values: 0 to 4999.

IndexEnd.description: The end index for the array job. Valid values: 0 to 4999. The value must be greater than or equal to \`IndexStart\`.

IndexStep.description:
The step size for the array job index.

> For example, if an array job has \`IndexStart\`=1, \`IndexEnd\`=5, and \`IndexStep\`=2, the job contains three subjobs with index values of 1, 3, and 5. Your application can access these values through environment variables.

TaskSustainable.description:
Specifies whether the job is a long-running job.

- true: The job is a background service job.

- false: The job is a batch job.

The default value is false.
